name: Love Mothers
source:
In this game, you immerse yourself in the life of a single mother who lives together with her son. The protagonist is the owner of a cafeteria and, after spending a long time without a partner, she and her son begin to develop a relationship beyond the typical mother and son. However, this type of relationship is not favored by society, which presents a moral and emotional conflict in the game.

The player assumes the role of the mother and is faced with difficult decisions that can have significant consequences. She must make the best decisions to maintain the balance between her love for her son and established social norms. The player's choices can influence the development of the story and determine whether misfortune occurs or whether a satisfactory resolution is found for the characters involved.

Throughout the game, sensitive issues will be explored and moral dilemmas presented, challenging the player to reflect on the consequences of their actions and make ethical decisions in difficult situations. The story seeks to generate a deep emotional and narrative experience, inviting reflection on love, family and social norms.

[From [url=https://qt-games.itch.io/love-mothers-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在本作中，你将走进一位与儿子同住的单身母亲的生活。主人公经营着一家咖啡餐馆，长期没有伴侣的她，与儿子逐渐发展出超越寻常母子关系的感情。然而，这样的关系并不被社会接受，由此引发了游戏中的道德与情感冲突。

玩家将扮演母亲，面对可能造成重大后果的艰难抉择。她必须尽力在对儿子的爱与既有社会规范之间维持平衡。玩家的选择会影响故事发展，决定人物最终遭遇不幸，还是找到令人满意的解决方式。

游戏将探索敏感议题，呈现道德困境，促使玩家思考行为的后果，并在艰难处境中作出合乎伦理的决定。故事力求带来深刻的情感与叙事体验，邀请玩家反思爱情、家庭与社会规范。

[摘自[url=https://qt-games.itch.io/love-mothers-demo]itch.io[/url]]
